ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Client development, Target and later stages need Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Client_development", CASE(StageName, "Target", 1, "Conversation", 2, "Terms discussed", 3, "Terms sent", 4, "Terms signed", 5, 0) >= 1, ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Next step date before moving to Target.
